althingi_lagasafn.name: Alþingi — Lagasafn
althingi_lagasafn.notes: Use the live official law page for verification. Bulk SGML snapshots are useful for discovery/indexing but can lag later amendments.

althingi_open_xml.name: Alþingi — open parliamentary XML
althingi_open_xml.notes: Official open XML: bills/matters, committee stages, speeches, votes. Alþingi warns that most exports lack a formal schema, may change without notice, and normally update daily. Requires a non-default User-Agent (default httpx UA gets 403'd) and mixed D.M.YYYY/ISO date formats depending on endpoint; parse responses as bytes, not decoded text.

heradsdomstolar.name: Héraðsdómstólar (District Courts)
heradsdomstolar.notes: Rulings from ~2015+ across 8 district courts. RSS feeds and PDF/case listing endpoints are usable without JS; robots.txt disallows /domar*, so retrieval should stay on RSS and listing/pagination routes rather than crawling ruling pages directly.

landsrettur.name: Landsréttur (Court of Appeals)
landsrettur.notes: Rulings from 2018+. Search results render client-side; listing/pagination endpoints work without JS. robots.txt disallows /domar*, so avoid direct crawling of ruling pages.

haestirettur.name: Hæstiréttur (Supreme Court)
haestirettur.authority_label: Official supreme court judgment — highest domestic precedent
haestirettur.notes: Rulings from 1999+. Listing/pagination endpoints work without JS. robots.txt disallows /domar*, so avoid direct crawling of ruling pages.

ees_gagnagrunnur.name: EES-gagnagrunnur
ees_gagnagrunnur.publisher: Stjórnarráð Íslands / Ministry for Foreign Affairs
ees_gagnagrunnur.notes: Tracks EEA acts and Icelandic handling. Do not equate an EU act or EEA relevance with domestic Icelandic applicability. The database states that Iceland-specific information before its 2017 introduction may be incomplete.

efta_eea_lex.name: EFTA — EEA-Lex
efta_eea_lex.notes: Useful for EEA incorporation/JCD factsheets. EFTA states EEA-Lex is informational and does not replace applicable legal sources.

eur_lex.name: EUR-Lex / CELLAR
eur_lex.publisher: Publications Office of the European Union
eur_lex.notes: An EU act appearing here must never, by that fact alone, be represented as applicable Icelandic law.

stjornartidindi.name: Stjórnartíðindi
stjornartidindi.notes: PoC registry entry only; a structured adapter should be added once a reliable supported interface is confirmed.
